title: Round 773 (F1079): MAP MEMORY LAYOUT closed - loader 0x43B600 reads TWO cell arrays (buffer1 [map+0x108] = 3 bytes per 2x2 block = prerendered tile layer, buffer2 [map+0x10C] = 14 bytes per cell = raw file records), both column-major stride h; 0x5600FC = per-atlas-file 324-byte slot array semantics settled; prerender tile blit 0x43B9A0
objective: Map the in-memory cell layout written by loader 0x43B600 and reconcile with the file-side 14-byte cell record (F1074).
question: What do the two heap buffers hold, how are they indexed, and who consumes buffer1?
method: disasm 0x43B6BA-0x43B81D (loader tail: two allocs + reads + crit-section loop + big-map path), 0x43C9F0-0x43CA3C (walkability reader indexing), census of [reg+0x108]/[reg+0x10C] reads in 0x43A000-0x43E000, disasm consumers 0x43B9A0-0x43BB03 (prerender tile blit) and 0x43C3A0-0x43C420 (twin), boundary scan for entry 0x43B9A0.
scope: map object heap buffers +0x108/+0x10C; slot array 0x5600FC; prerender blit path.

cell_analysis.buffer2_0x10c: alloc(w*h*14) [0x43B6ED: (w*h)*8-(w*h) <<1 = 14*wh]; raw 14-byte file records, NO transform; index = 14*(arg1*h + arg2) (0x43CA1F imul eax(h),arg1; add arg2; lea*8-sub <<1 = *14) - column-major stride h; walkability = test byte[cell+0],1 (set=blocked, ret 0; clear/unloaded/oob = ret 1 walkable) - matches F1074 byte0 bit0
cell_analysis.buffer1_0x108: alloc((w*h)/4*3) [0x43B6A7: (w*h+3)>>2 *3] = 3 bytes per 2x2 cell block; block index = h*(x>>1) + (y>>1) (0x43BA31-0x43BA4E: (x)>>1 * h + (y)>>1) - column-major stride h, SAME convention as buffer2; entry {byte0 = atlas file index b, word1..2 = frame/aux}
cell_analysis.prerender_gate: v = b + b/14 (0x6DB6DB6D magic div 14, add-back at 0x43BA65-0x43BA73); GATES: v%14 <= 2 (tile layer, 0x43BA78 idiv 14 cmp edx,2 jg exit), v <= 0x45, frame word != 0xFFFF - the exact complement of F1069's object-layer gates (v%14>=3) on the same math family
cell_analysis.slot_array_0x5600fc: ebx = v*9*9*4 = 324*v (0x43BA8C-0x43BA93); slot = 0x5600FC + 324*v; [slot+0x38]/[slot+0x3C] = sub-library pointers (0x43BAA9/0x43BAC0); 0x466130(slot, frame) = frame resolve (F1069); settles R771's secondary note: ONE array serves BOTH entity type-slots (idx=byte[ent+0x8C], stored to [ent+0x90]) AND per-atlas-file draw slots - it is the atlas/asset slot table, stride 0x144
cell_analysis.blit: screen pos x=(sx-[map+0x12C])*48 / y=(sy-[map+0x130])*32 (0x43BADA-0x43BAF3: sub anchors, shl 5 / *3*16); dest window 0x8AB7A8; draw call 0x45E8E0 with clip 0xFFFF pair + size push 0x300/0x480
cell_analysis.entry_0x43b9a0: prerender tile blit entry: ecx=map, args (x bounded by w AND x%2==0, y bounded by h AND y%2==0, y >= [map+0x130]+0x18) - only even coords = 2x2 block corners; preceded by jump table 0x43B976 (scroll-step helper family 0x43B8CC/0x43B8F2/0x43B932... = velocity*dt -> [map+0x134]/[map+0x138] accumulators, F1065 consumers)
cell_analysis.loader_tail: crit-section init loop 0x43B756: 56 objects at 0x5612B4..0x565994 stride 0x144 (0x465FE0=enter); per-load re-seize loop over slot table ranges (0x5600FC+324*k with companion array 0x56B22C stride 0x104, 0x4660E0); small-map check: if w<100 or h<100 -> [map+0x18C]=0 (disables big-map path 0x43B440); [map]=1 loaded; CloseHandle [0x4760E4]; ret 1 (0x43B812 = open-fail ret 0)
cell_analysis.twin_consumer_0x43c3ce: 0x43C3A0-region repeats the same buffer1 read + v%14<=2 gate (function family twin of 0x43B9A0)

exe_trace.read_path: frame render -> prerender blit 0x43B9A0(even x,y) -> buffer1 block -> atlas slot 0x5600FC+324*v -> 0x466130 frame -> 0x45E8E0 to window; object layers walk buffer2 via F1069 blits; walkability via 0x43C9F0 on buffer2

audit_vs_exe.F1074: file-side 14B record map confirmed as an in-memory passthrough (buffer2 = raw records, no re-encoding)
audit_vs_exe.F1069: its '预渲染 <=2 瓦片层' source now identified: buffer1 per-2x2-block atlas index with the SAME v=b+b/14 family and complementary gate
audit_vs_exe.F1071: buffer pointers live INSIDE the embedded map object at +0x108/+0x10C (consistent with embedded model; dtor 0x43B190 frees them per F1075)
audit_vs_exe.R771_note: 0x5600FC stride-324 array = atlas/asset slot table used by both entity spawn (idx=byte[ent+0x8C]) and tile draw (idx=v) - NOT an FX array

contrast.buffer1: 3B per 2x2 block, prerendered tile layer (k0-2), column-major stride h
contrast.buffer2: 14B per cell, raw file records incl. object layers + walkability, column-major stride h

verdict: In-memory map layout closed: the loader images the file into buffer2 (14B/cell, column-major stride h, byte0 bit0 = blocked) and builds buffer1 (3B per 2x2 block = prerendered tile layer: atlas file byte + frame word, gate v=b+b/14 with v%14<=2, v<=0x45) consumed by blit 0x43B9A0 and its twin 0x43C3CE via the 324-byte-per-file atlas slot array at 0x5600FC; both buffers and the slot table now have producers and consumers fully paired.
evidence_level_note: All from .text disasm; buffer1 block-stride reads as h*[(x>>1)]+(y>>1) per byte-level instruction sequence.
